chunks: And whatever was in H from ʿImrān al-Ḥalabī, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from Jaʿfar ibn Bashīr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from ʿImrān al-Ḥalabī,
and his kunyah is Abū al-Faḍl.

key_terms.أَبُو الْفَضْلِ: The kunyah by which ʿImrān al-Ḥalabī is identified.
key_terms.الْحَلَبِيِّ: A nisbah identifying the narrator as al-Ḥalabī.
key_terms.كُنْيَتُهُ: His kunyah, an honorific naming form used in Arabic biographical identification.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to ʿImrān al-Ḥalabī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which al-Ṣadūq transmits reports from ʿImrān al-Ḥalabī in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. It also identifies ʿImrān al-Ḥalabī by his kunyah, Abū al-Faḍl, making the entry relevant to hadith transmission and narrator identification.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: And whatever is narrated from Imran Al-Halabi, I have narrated it from my father - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him -  from Sad ibn Abdullah, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab, from Jafar ibn Bashir, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Imran Al-Halabi,
